bounded_membership_evidence.method: Reused the immediately preceding read-only hash-pinned saved-index-chain check. No record-body or full-library reconstruction.
bounded_membership_evidence.limits: Index identity nonmembership is not token-peer clearance, complete protected-query/scope clearance, a fresh whole-library audit, semantic admission or platform approval.

variant_attention.reason: RTPI and NCS publish differently detailed town-planner apprenticeship names. Do not infer independent concepts or count-only variants from their wording. Independent source/semantic review must decide treatment.

remaining_checks: Exact/token-peer/closed-alias comparison against current full literals
Independent complete-literal semantic and variant review
Intended campaign/service/purpose and protected-query scope review
Registered source/review provenance and applicable dated freshness gates
Root admission decision; separate human exclusion approval and release gates

rows.feasibility_intent_screen: The full title explicitly requests a vocational apprenticeship in town planning. Preserve legitimate town planning and property-development intent when the apprenticeship intent is absent.
rows.scope_limit: Only the complete verbatim apprenticeship title may be evaluated for EXACT research after all admission checks. No abbreviated, phrase or broad exclusion is proposed.
